historical_context.time_period: Undated pre-imperial-contact or early-contact Sa'ueia daily life; no exact year is canonical.
historical_context.location: The west intake terrace of a breeding ground on the sub-Umbros side of the Sa'ueia continent.
historical_context.summary: Reserve keeper Veyr must ration an eclipse-short nursery culture when a prismwake mat closes its sugar release and an old-return family and an archive-poor new household make competing claims.

public_facts.text: Breeding grounds concentrate infants, infirm adults, graft patients, and caretakers, so their nourishment depends on supply moving toward bodies that cannot simply follow it.
Nursery reserve culture joins producer sugar, road-processed minerals, glassback-carried heat, water, and low-contamination microbial renewal; no one species owns the whole input chain.
Trophic credit is witnessed by ecological partners and portable archives, so old return histories can buy earlier access while archive loss makes present contribution harder to price.
Umbros totality is regular but materially constrains warmth, fresh producer energy, visibility, and the time available to negotiate a safe ration.

ambient_pressures.text: Nursery caretakers own triage among residents but cannot command the road, mat, herd, or grove to provide missing inputs.
An old family's real prior credit can compound into privileged access even when a new household supplies useful current labor and clean material.
A ration that protects this eclipse can weaken tomorrow's cycle if it overdraws mat regrowth, herd heat, road credit, lantern sugars, or caretaker labor.

groups.label: West terrace reserve keepers and nursery caretakers
institutional_logic: Keep infants, infirm residents, and graft patients fed through eclipse while exposing rather than privately owning allocation decisions.
material_incentives: Maintain warm clean culture, keep intake channels open, avoid exhausting staff, and preserve enough partner credit for the next cycle.
internal_shames: Spending another organism's reserve by declaration
prestige_markers: Claims legible from both sides of the ration rail
taboo_triggers: A keeper claiming ownership of the whole intake seam
emotional_display_norms: Pressure is shown through precise cup depth, open archives, low work posture, and visible throat or flank signals; comedy survives because the basins do not care how solemnly they are stirred.
trust_defaults: Trusts plural material receipts more than prestige or need stated alone.

groups.label: Families with long witnessed return histories
institutional_logic: Convert years of ecological repayment into advance access during shortage without admitting that repeated recognition is becoming class power.
material_incentives: Feed route-tired breeders before the next circuit, preserve portable archives, and keep old credit liquid across several partners.
internal_shames: A dark road around a polished cord
Public proof that dependents damaged a partner
Being treated as ordinary current need
prestige_markers: Braided archive cords recognized by several routes
taboo_triggers: Publishing lineage-linked damage without provenance care
emotional_display_norms: Confidence appears as still posture, clean equipment, and concise claims; visible offense is permitted when old credit is treated as fiction.
trust_defaults: Trusts durable archive witness and expects unfamiliar households to build comparable history.

groups.label: Newly divided or displaced households with weak durable records
institutional_logic: Turn current work, clean material, and visible need into standing before exhaustion makes future repayment impossible.
material_incentives: Secure one warm measure, rebuild portable records, keep providers able to work, and avoid permanent dependence on another family's archive.
internal_virtues: Refusal to borrow identity from a patron
internal_shames: Work accepted while standing is refused
A new cord held by an old family
prestige_markers: Fresh work witnessed by more than one species
A repaired partner that signals recognition
taboo_triggers: Being called unremembered as if it meant useless
Patronage that owns the household's new history
emotional_display_norms: Dignity is maintained through prepared work, clean bundles, and restraint at boundaries; fatigue remains chemically visible.
trust_defaults: Trusts current co-work and public multi-species receipt more than inherited assurances.

groups.label: Prismwake mat, glassback herd, candle road, and lantern grove
institutional_logic: Exchange sugar, heat, minerals, light, transport, and memory under separate embodied contracts rather than behaving as one utility.
material_incentives: Protect regrowth, calves, clean decomposition, root reserves, safe traffic, and future reciprocal labor.
internal_shames: A warning that drives all useful traffic elsewhere
taboo_triggers: A human-shaped promise substituted for material
emotional_display_norms: Agreement and pressure are expressed through colored tissue, plate heat, candle spacing, root light, movement, and access geometry.
trust_defaults: Each partner remembers different evidence and may cooperate while another refuses.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Keepers can decide which cups leave a basin but cannot manufacture or command the inputs that fill and warm it.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Give Veyr choices over sampling, repair, visible claims, cup depth, and allocation; make unilateral declarations create split accounts rather than obedience.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Durable multi-partner credit is useful risk sharing and also lets recognized families receive present resources before present labor.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep Ossa's prior credit real while showing how advance access compounds into status and can conceal current externalized damage.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Households with lost or shallow records must spend bodily capacity and material before their contributions become durable credit.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make Rin's clean bundles and repair labor visible while preserving the time and exhaustion required for several partners to sample them.

observer_read: Future labor offered as if already complete
target_self_read: A household beginning its own account
People paying in the only time available to them
misread_patterns: Confuses missing archive with missing contribution
Treats slow ecological sampling as evidence of low worth
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let Ossa defend genuine risk accounting without turning every unfamiliar family into a moral failure.

observer_read: Polished cords substituted for current work
target_self_read: Families drawing on obligations they actually repaid
misread_patterns: May flatten real prior sacrifice into theft
May underestimate why ecological partners price unknown claims cautiously
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let Rin recognize the material reality of old credit while resisting its conversion into permanent priority.

observer_read: A reserve system that can be bargained with
target_self_read: Not available as one private account; each body protects a different reserve and timescale
misread_patterns: Treats coincident signals as unified consent
Mistakes a keeper's comparative expertise for command authority
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep partner responses separate and visible; an opened road candle does not imply mat or herd consent.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A caretaker who can measure and ration the commons' nursery culture while several other organisms retain authority over its inputs.
failure_modes: Closing a rail as if closure made food

role_pressure_fields.summary: A mobile family representative carrying valid inherited records and the expectation that durable repayment should provide credit under shortage.
obligations: Answer for dependent-route damage without accepting automatic personal guilt

role_pressure_fields.summary: A representative whose household has useful material and skill but lacks an intact durable archive after a story-local loss.
obligations: Avoid patronage that owns the new account
failure_modes: Treating need as sufficient ecological evidence
Accepting relief that leaves no recognized claim

known_context.text: Veyr knows the west terrace layout, basin thresholds, nursery demand, public claims, material sampling routines, and the visible signals of local road, mat, herd, and grove partners.

beliefs.text: Veyr believes a ration is legitimate only when its costs and unfilled obligations remain visible to the people and organisms carrying them.

misreads.text: Veyr may overestimate how much public accounting protects a low-credit household from the immediate bodily cost of being sampled.

must_not_know.text: Veyr must not know private ecological intent beyond visible color, heat, route, material, and prior-conduct signals.

known_context.text: Ossa knows her family's archived repayments, current adult needs, protected dependent herds, and the obligations she can credibly pledge on the next circuit.

beliefs.text: Ossa believes advance access is the proper purpose of credit whose prior costs were real.

misreads.text: Ossa may treat archive-poor current work as socially sympathetic but institutionally weak because its future reliability has not been witnessed.

must_not_know.text: Ossa must not know whether the road, mat, herd, or keeper will accept the advance before their public responses.

known_context.text: Rin knows the household's clean bundles, completed repair, lost archive context, exhausted provider, and immediate work capacity.

beliefs.text: Rin believes current useful contribution should begin independent standing before the household is strong enough to complete a whole circuit.

misreads.text: Rin may read caution about untested future repayment as contempt for the new household rather than a real ecological risk price.

must_not_know.text: Rin must not know what old family obligations remain valid except what Ossa and the public archive reveal.

author_only_boundaries.text: Veyr, Ossa, Rin, Scored Blue, the two families, and the particular shortfall are story-local inventions and are not promoted as named vault canon.
The fixture does not establish one morally correct ration. Each ending exposes a different allocation, class, labor, or future-supply cost.
No road, mat, herd, grove, family, or keeper has a hidden unified view of the whole intake compact; apparent coordination is a public overlap of separate interests.

open_questions.question: What forms of archive loss, adoption, household fission, or displacement most often reset a Sa'ueia family's ecological credit?
open_questions.notes: The fixture uses a story-local flood loss without canonizing a general legal rule.

open_questions.question: Which nutrient, heat, or contamination thresholds require full, half, or deferred reserve measures for different Sa'ueia life stages?
open_questions.notes: The fixture uses coarse safe/unsafe bands and visible cup depths, not a physiological table.

open_questions.question: How portable are prismwake sugar tissues before their own memory-bearing cells reject storage or transit?
open_questions.notes: The fixture keeps the producer lobe physically attached to the terrace water channel and treats portable skim as immediately consumed reserve input.
